### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/sdui-parser`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **12** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`, `packages/spec/src/kernel/functional-completeness.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx`  _(via DatasetMeasureSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_

⛔ **5** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v15.mdx`  _(via PageTabsProps (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`, `packages/spec/src/kernel/functional-completeness.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **138** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7053333e1e2194cea2e21d8b2e1c9b6f081fcfa6` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `fa9e366c44a895f3660c22c0d34202e3ec23fc53` — the merge of head `ef6276c0e9cc91a3fdcc9acc5acea9e897b0fb7f` into base `7053333e1e2194cea2e21d8b2e1c9b6f081fcfa6`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin fa9e366c44a895f3660c22c0d34202e3ec23fc53 && git checkout fa9e366c44a895f3660c22c0d34202e3ec23fc53
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 7053333e1e2194cea2e21d8b2e1c9b6f081fcfa6 ef6276c0e9cc91a3fdcc9acc5acea9e897b0fb7f && git checkout -B drift-repro 7053333e1e2194cea2e21d8b2e1c9b6f081fcfa6 && git merge --no-ff ef6276c0e9cc91a3fdcc9acc5acea9e897b0fb7f

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7053333e1e2194cea2e21d8b2e1c9b6f081fcfa6
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 7053333e1e2194cea2e21d8b2e1c9b6f081fcfa6` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ef6276c0e9cc91a3fdcc9acc5acea9e897b0fb7f`
Local-runs: none

Read: card #20638 (body and all 7 comments, including the triage target rule `5895893448`, claim `5896593369`, report `5896951506`, takeover claim `5903537467` and report `5904014004`), PR #20706 (body, its one comment, 6 commits, 20-path file list, the net diff against merge base `7053333e1e`), #20436 / `3cf6449389` as the precedent, the 35 check-runs on this head (read once), and objectui at both pins through REST compare, the trees API and raw files. Nothing was built, run or re-run; the anchor hashes below are sha1 over the fetched raw bytes.

### ① Derived judgments

**Containment (REST compare, not the dev's table).** `C...db11afd4967c` for each target reads `status: ahead, behind_by: 0`: `a5841be351` (ahead 23), `99878d8e3a` (48), `49f76725aa` (47), `ae582b70a` (21), `5b2ea17570` (17), `3100bef65c` (6). Control: `dd3f7e1be356...db11afd4967c` reads ahead 113 / behind 0 (113 commits, the range the changeset digests). `db11afd4967c...main` reads ahead 23 / behind 0, so the pin is an ancestor of objectui `main`. The commit is `fix(plugin-grid,types): six of the eight keys ObjectGridSchema declares take effect or are retired (objectui#11068) (#11130)`, committed 2026-09-29T18:01:28Z; `apps/console/package.json` at the pin is `@object-ui/console 17.6.0`. Right.

**`@objectstack/spec` — accept set: no change; public surface: text only. Right.** Every changed line of the 13 `.ts` files under `packages/spec/src`, read off `git diff -U0` against the merge base, is one of three shapes: a comment line (358: `api-methods-batch-conformance.test.ts` 16, `functional-completeness.ts` 36, `component.test.ts` 50, `component.zod.ts` 212, `dataset.zod.ts` 10, `view.zod.ts` 34), a `+ '…'` string-continuation line inside the `reason` field of the six `18.*-unit-in-key.ts` entries (43) and their projection in `registry.ts` (43, every hunk between lines 12436 and 16850, inside the `os-generated semantic:18` region that spans 5971 to 18576 — the generated region only, as the entries carry), or the `FormField.span` `.describe()` line in `view.zod.ts` (1 removed, 1 added; the key, `z.enum(['auto', 'full'])` and `.default('auto')` are byte-identical, only `dd3f7e1be356` → `db11afd4967c` inside the sentence). No key, default, enum member, export, regex or code token moves; `check:api-surface` (Lint and Repo Gates) is green on the head. The published text that moves is that describe (the JSON-schema description, and its projection in the regenerated `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx`, 2 rows) and the six entries' `reason` text (compiled into the registry). The ADR-0087 reason block calls the six strings "description text"; the field is `reason` — a naming looseness, not a false claim.

**`@objectstack/sdui-parser` — no accept-set or public-surface change. Right.** The only file is `objectui-lockstep.json`: `rev`, `revDate` and `recordedAgainstPin` move (3 lines); no source under `src/` changes, and the file is outside the package's published `files` (`dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`), so no changeset is owed, as in #20436. `check:sdui-lockstep` (Lint and Repo Gates) is green. The `revDate` spelling changed from `…Z` to `…+00:00`: the generator writes git `%cI`, and both name the commit's committer instant above — benign.

**`@objectstack/console` — the bundle moves 113 objectui commits; ObjectStack-authorable contract unchanged. Right.** `.objectui-sha` moves; `sdui.manifest.json` is regenerated from the built tree (still 107 components; the diff is descriptions and `type: string` → `[string, object]` widenings on the per-locale-map label inputs of objectui#10993 / #11039 / #11061 and kin) and `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` moves with it (`objectuiSha`, `modulesRoot .cache/objectui-db11afd4967c/apps/console`, `objectuiWorkspaceVersion 17.6.0`, new sha256). The narrowings objectui declares in the range (`ObjectMapConfigSchema.strict()`, the content-channel refusals, the bare `pivot` `drillDown` retirement, the `globalFilters[].options` lift) are objectui's own validator and type surfaces, carried as the changeset's entry list; nothing in `packages/spec` moves with them, exactly the #20436 shape.

**The re-measured numbers, re-taken at the pin (nine, beyond the three asked):**
- tracked files: the recursive trees API at `db11afd4967c` lists 9546 blobs (not truncated) and 9283 at `dd3f7e1be356` — the two file totals every entry states.
- `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:2037` reads `export const ObjectMapConfigSchema = z.object({`, closed at `:2046` by `}).strict();`; `LIST_VIEW_LOCAL_OVERRIDES` opens at `:944` with no `'map'` member; `ObjectMapSchema.map` binds the schema at `:2149`. So the three re-pointed anchors (`1835` → `2037`, `809` → `944`, and `ObjectView.tsx:2043` → `2280`, which reads `case 'map':`) hold.
- **The falsified claim, re-read (the human read the first dev asked for):** `plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx` at the pin: `getMapConfig` at `:388`, `const result = ObjectMapConfigSchema.safeParse(config);` at `:409`, then `if (!result.success) console.warn('[ObjectMap] Invalid map configuration:', result.error.format())` and `return { ...config, style: … }`; `hasCoordinateBinding` at `:487`, the refusal arm at `:1285`. The qualified sentences — the parse now FAILS on an undeclared key, `getMapConfig` warns it by name (the formatted error carries the `unrecognized_keys` issue), the read is still warn-only, the spread of the authored block is still returned, and the flatten whitelist (`ListView.tsx:85` `FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_SPELLING`, `:146` `resolveListMapConfig`) still drops the key in silence — are true at the pin. "`objectui validate` refuses the node with an `unrecognized_keys` issue at `map`" follows from the strict schema being the one `ObjectMapSchema.map` binds, and is what objectui's own `5157-object-map-config-strict.md` declares. The spec changeset's summary of it is accurate.
- `containers.tsx` `946-952` and `1171-1177` are the two `item.icon && LazyIcon name={item.icon}` icon blocks (the tabs and accordion triggers); `:1005` and `:1220` are the `items` inputs documented `[{ label, value?, icon?, count?, visibleWhen?, children }]` and `[{ label, icon?, collapsed?, children }]`.
- `plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx:252` reads `{ name: 'icon', type: 'string' }`; `packages/types/src/objectql.ts:4302` reads `limit?: number;`.
- `ObjectGrid.tsx:4637-4664` hashes (blob header plus bytes) to `c88443302d40c2db739ddb235470bafa29056e2e`, and `hooks/useBulkExecutor.ts:298-303` to `01083348330f10a201cdf1078b4c21c236402b6a` — both as `api-methods-batch-conformance.test.ts` now states.
- `FormField.span`: `plugin-form/src/autoLayout.ts:58-69` is `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES` (textarea, markdown, html, grid, richtext in both spellings), `resolveColSpan` at `:154` returns the grid width on `span === 'full'`; `spanLadderFor` is `packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx:204-231` with its call at `:2848` and emits one clamped class per multi-column tier. The describe's claim holds at the pin. (The record calls the file `form.tsx` without its package; it is the components renderer, not a plugin-form file — the same spelling #20436 used, and the gate resolves anchors by suffix.)
- Not re-taken: the lit-control grep totals (14704 `objectstack`, 5545 `@objectstack/spec`, `timeout` 1197, `useState` 2449, `TTL` 181, `tenant` 1200, and the rest), which need a whole-tree grep. The dark counts they calibrate are 0 at every pin, the file totals they sit beside are verified, and the method line is unchanged.

**Migration registry.** Only the generated region moves, and it moves by exactly the six entries' text (43 lines each side, identical hunks); `check:migration-registry` (Lint and Repo Gates) is green on the head.

### ② Semver level

**`@objectstack/console` `minor` — right, and the entry list derives faithfully.** Between the pins objectui's `.changeset/` gained 99 files and lost none (trees diff; 70 stock files were edited in place and are rightly not entries). 89 carry a package frontmatter and 10 carry an empty one (release-nothing: `10088-json-fences-parse`, the two `10803-dead-citation-sweep-*`, `10895-…relatedlist-client-sort-gate`, `10903-today-reference-day-rule`, `10905-types-stale-docblocks`, `10987-retire-list-view-tabs-fixture`, `11024-spec-gate-canonical-operator-fixtures`, `11040-comment-mask-tracked-files`, `8071-master-detail-other-half-slice-18`) — the changeset's "89 releasing of 99". The declared levels are `patch` 107 and `minor` 36 package-lines, no `major`, so the highest is `minor`. The digest's positional breaking rule (`hasBreakingAnnotation`: an emphasis run or block opening with the word) flags exactly six: `9256-input-content-channels`, `9256-public-blocks-content-channels`, `9256-remeasure-content-channels` (each `@object-ui/types`), `10946-expression-wire-slots-by-reference` (`@object-ui/types`), `10932-pivot-drilldown-retired` (`@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`), `retire-options-shorthand-lift-4356` (`@object-ui/core`) — the six entries the file marks BREAKING (`7e8b3c033`, `f6fb83f0c`, `2049b03df`, `d570eaa59`, `cc4e47638`, `a51fa0cca`). The file carries 89 releasing rows and 20 `_(no changeset)_` rows against the compare's 113 commits; four of the 20 spot-checked through the commits API (`51401e63c`, `80c2d5e61`, `a93ba8792`, `af2221d45`) carry no `.changeset/` path. The list, counts and level are what `scripts/bump-objectui.sh` writes through `objectui-changeset-digest.mjs`, in #20436's shape.

**ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` — the maintainer's ruling (`5903537467`), recorded in `b4cd814ec2` (+20/-1, the placeholder line only, as the takeover claim's surface allowed); the gate accepts it (Check Changeset, green). Every sentence of the reason block judged against THIS diff:**
- "moves `.objectui-sha` and the artefacts that travel with it (…)" — true; the parenthetical omits the spec changeset and the regenerated `view.mdx`, which the second paragraph and the PR name; not false.
- "adds, removes or renames no ObjectStack-authorable key: no Zod schema, no spec declaration and no stored `sys_metadata` shape moves … no FROM/TO prescription of its own" — true (①); the block carries no prescription, so the category's one mechanical refusal does not bite.
- "the re-measure changes text only: source comments, one `.describe()` sentence (`FormField.span`) and the description text of six semantic migration entries, with the generated `migrations/registry.ts` and reference page that project them … no key, default, enum member or export" — true (①), with the `reason`-field naming noted above.
- "the 6 declared-breaking entries listed above are objectui's OWN package surfaces (`@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/core` and `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`), each already carrying its upstream record" — true: the six declare exactly those three packages (types five times, core once, plugin-dashboard once alongside types), each in its own upstream changeset.
- "where one of them mirrors an ObjectStack-authorable key, the ledger entry belongs to the `packages/spec` PR that lands the mirror, never to the pin bump, whose diff contains no such key" — true of this diff: none of the six mirrors a key this diff changes, because this diff changes no key. (The closest kin, objectui#4356's `globalFilters[].options`, moves objectui onto the spec's existing `{ value, label }` form; the spec side does not move here.)
- "a claim about THIS diff, not a per-entry re-measurement of the 6" — true and correctly scoped.
The ruling is not re-opened; its written reasons hold.

**`@objectstack/spec` `patch` — right.** The describe and the six `reason` strings ship in `dist` (the JSON-schema description; the compiled registry, which `objectstack migrate meta` and the upgrade guide read) and in the reference page, so `skip-changeset` would be wrong, and no accept set moves, so `minor` would be wrong. The body states the one falsified record accurately (above). #20436 took the same level for the same describe.

**`Clause-②: no` — right,** on the PR body and in both changesets. No accept set on an ObjectStack-authorable surface widens or narrows; objectui's own narrowings ride in the console bundle as upstream declarations, the reading #20436 gave its 41.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **First dev's flag, "that prose wants a human read"** (the `ListMapConfigSchema` record in `view.zod.ts`): read against `ObjectMap.tsx`, `objectql.zod.ts` and `ListView.tsx` at the pin; every qualified sentence is true there (①). Answered.

Q2 (widening to the lockstep and the 49 citations) was done on the same branch (`690bf369c3`, `db448bfbe0`, `d8bac3877d`); the PR body says the PM seat requested it after the first report, and the card carries no dispatch record of that widening between `5896951506` and the takeover claim.
